items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: That's surprising to me because I can't find any Rapolo influence anywhere.

ctx.x: But it was in the summer that Benny played his first lake jobs that New Orleans Rhythm Kings were around. As I remembered, Rapolo had left them by this time, so I guess we'd better drop Rapolo's name from a direct influence. But Rapolo had made the records that all the kids were listening to. The New Orleans Rhythm Kings were the most popular hot band in Chicago. And he would have that touch with it.
That's surprising to me because I can't find any Rapolo influence anywhere.
Not in Benny's playing with it. All right.
